description: This file contains functions and configurations for managing DHCPv6 protocol in a network environment, including initialization, setup, renewal, and teardown of DHCPv6 leases, utilizing external scripts and configuration files.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_init_config
methods.description: Initializes DHCPv6 protocol configuration with supported options.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_prefix
methods.description: Appends a given prefix to another string.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_sendopts
methods.description: Adds send options to the DHCPv6 request.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_setup
methods.description: Sets up the DHCPv6 protocol on a specified interface with configuration options.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_renew
methods.description: Triggers a renewal of the DHCPv6 lease via signal.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_teardown
methods.description: Terminates DHCPv6 session on the specified interface.
